## Pull request overview

Fixes `provider:'object'` dashboard widget regressions by preventing provider config objects from leaking into `data` props (causing table/pivot crashes) and improving provider handling across both dashboard renderers.

**Changes:**
- Centralized `isObjectProvider()` and added `provider:'object'` handling to `DashboardGridLayout` (charts/tables/pivots).
- Prevented `options.data` from being spread into table/pivot schemas for `provider:'object'` and added array-guards in `DataTableRenderer` + `PivotTable`.
- Improved `ObjectChart` UX by rendering visible loading / missing-dataSource messages; added 2 regression tests and updated roadmap.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/utils.ts | Adds shared `isObjectProvider()` helper. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx | Stops `options.data` leaking into `data-table`/`pivot` schemas for `provider:'object'`; imports shared helper. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx | Adds `provider:'object'` routing for charts/tables/pivots using shared helper. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Guards `schema.data` to ensure array-only operations. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/PivotTable.tsx | Guards `schema.data` to avoid iteration over non-arrays. |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx | Adds visible loading and missing-`dataSource` fallback messages. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.widgetData.test.tsx | Adds regression tests to ensure table/pivot don’t crash when provider configs appear in `options.data`. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the fix as completed. |
</details>
